title: 第2章 D牌D到我自己？
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一个区域1百万人，进入游戏之前是什么状态，现在就是什么状态。

绝对有人正在生病。

在蓝星，发炎感冒只是小毛病。

但在求生游戏里，这些都是拖累进度导致死亡的主因。

没人能拒绝救命药。

李知刚把消炎药挂上去。

定价每颗4铜币。

刚一挂上去，私信就响个不停。

等她关闭提示音时，私信已经99+，随手点开一条：

FSDAFEWFER：[太黑了吧？新手礼包一共10块钱，你一颗消炎药要4块？]

FSDAFEWFER：[这样，我出1铜一颗，买10颗，你再送我1颗，10铜11颗，可以吧？]

还我三星五费！！！：[要不我把飞舟也送给你？再顺道过去给你炒两个菜？]

贪得无厌的见多了。

贪得理直气壮的也不少。

但是这个人竟然说她黑！

她哪里黑了？

刷新一次就要2铜币。

还不知道以后能不能再刷出来，就算刷几十次之后真的刷出来了，算起来不也就相当于只收了个成本价吗？

你说一盒消炎药有24颗？

那她想买的天启微尘，想升级的大飞舟，想穿的大棉袄，想盖的大被子还有刷新时候点击的人工不要钱了？

再说，消炎药绝对是当下甚至很长一段时间的稀缺物品、硬通货。

4铜币绝对童叟无欺！

李知把那些乞讨的道德绑架的骂人的全部拉黑，才点开下一个聊天框。

贪生paSS：[你好，我现在只有10铜，先买两颗，但是你能帮我留一颗吗？我明天来买。]

还我三星五费！！！：[你是我第一位客人，有优惠，10铜3颗。]

做生意就是这样。

见到爽快的，自己也能爽快点。

贪生paSS：[太好了！谢谢谢谢！]

李知将一盒药拆开，从两板里抽出一板，再从12颗里抠出3颗，放到了点击“交易”之后，就凭空出现的平台上。

【3颗消炎药，核实成功，交易成功。】

平台和三颗消炎药同时消失。

李知钱包数字从“1”瞬间涨到了“11”。

又找到爽快的买家卖了2颗消炎药和感冒药出去。

钱包数字很快到了“19”。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

There are 1 million people in an area. What was the state before entering the game and what is the state now.

Someone is definitely getting sick.

In Blue Star, inflammation and colds are just minor ailments.

But in survival games, these are the main reasons that slow down progress and lead to death.

No one can turn down life-saving medicine.

Li Zhigang hung up the anti-inflammatory medicine.

Priced at 4 copper coins each.

As soon as I hung up, the private messages started ringing off the hook.

By the time she turned off the notification sound, there were already 99+ private messages, so she casually clicked on one:

FSDAFEWFER: [Too dark, right?The novice gift package costs 10 yuan in total, but you want 4 yuan for an anti-inflammatory pill?]

FSDAFEWFER: [In this way, I will give you 1 copper each, buy 10, and you will give me another 1, making 10 coppers and 11, okay?]

Give me three stars and five fees!!!: [How about I give you the flying boat?Will you stop by and cook two dishes for you?]

I have seen too much greed.

There are many people who are greedy and self-righteous.

But this person actually called her evil!

What's wrong with her?

Refreshing it once costs 2 copper coins.

I don’t know if it will be available again in the future. Even if it does come out after dozens of times, wouldn’t it be equivalent to only charging the cost price?

You said there are 24 pills in a box of anti-inflammatory pills?

Then the Apocalypse Mote she wants to buy, the big spaceship she wants to upgrade, the big cotton-padded jacket she wants to wear, the big quilt she wants to cover, and the labor of clicking during refresh are free?

Besides, anti-inflammatories are definitely scarce items and hard currency now and even for a long time to come.

4 copper coins are absolutely worthless!

Li Zhi blocked all the begging, morally kidnapping, and curse words before clicking on the next chat box.

TanshengpaSS: [Hello, I only have 10 coppers now. I will buy two first, but can you save one for me?I'll buy it tomorrow.]

Give me three stars and five fees!!!: [You are my first customer, there is a discount, 10 coppers and 3 pieces.]

That's how business works.

When you see someone who is happy, you can also feel happy.

TanshengpaSS: [Great!Thank you!]

Li Zhi opened a box of medicines, pulled out one of the two pills, and then picked out 3 pills out of the 12 pills, and placed them on the platform that appeared out of thin air after clicking "Transaction".

[3 anti-inflammatory pills, verification successful, transaction successful.】

The platform and the three anti-inflammatory pills disappeared at the same time.

Li Zhi's wallet number instantly increased from "1" to "11".

I found a happy buyer and sold 2 anti-inflammatory pills and cold medicine.

The wallet number soon reached "19".
